entities.summary: Ernest Asi Afiesimama is a Nigerian environmental and climate scientist who has worked for the Nigerian Meteorological Agency and currently a consultant in environmental and climate affairs at Stern Integrated Projects He is also the Coordinator of Save Nigerian Environment Initiative. He was with the World Meteorological Organization; a specialised agency of the United Nations.
